records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Positive, engaged admin replied unprompted (email:2e61ab36) and already created a first project plus sent 1 invite, so momentum exists; but no key milestone by day 6 and "still getting used to the layout" suggests slow self-serve progress with 8 days left. Starter plan, no tickets.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Bright Labs' setup
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Glad to hear things are going well and the layout is starting to click. That's a normal first week.

Since you've got a project going, the natural next step is getting real work into it: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Once a few real tasks are in there, the rest of the setup tends to make more sense.

Happy to walk through that with you on a short call this week, or over email if that's easier -- just tell me what you're trying to track and I'll help you shape it.

Best,
Chidi
